meta.title: Bidding on a withdrawn event is refused

steps.note: Start a new event using the multi-stage create flow, whose default stage is Auction.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available pricing template required for line items and publishing.
Add one product so the event has a valid bid sheet.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor, making the later vendor bid attempt an invited-vendor scenario.
Publish the event so it can be withdrawn and exposed to the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Withdraw the entire project before any bid is submitted.
Confirm Procol records the project as withdrawn.
As the invited vendor, attempt to submit a bid and require Procol to refuse it.
Verify the buyer's Responses view contains no vendor response, proving no bid was created.
